goal: Automatically catch struct padding regressions to prevent wasted memory across data structures
Saves memory on frequently allocated and long-lived structures
reviewability: Check whether the failing CI is caused by this PR before deep review
agreement: Broad concept support for catching memory padding regressions in CI
Suggests opting out singletons when reordering harms logical grouping (hodlinator)
Suggests keeping guarded members near their mutex and avoiding churn for negligible gains (jonatack)
Questioned why CI warns about smaller padding losses than the configured limit (bartoli)

categories.name: build
why: P3 because adding static checks for struct padding bloat is a modest preventative improvement
It does not address release integrity, platform breakages, or CI reliability
